mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "List" searches VNEPS's public procurement-plan / tender-notice / award-result feed. "Detail" fetches full award/contract detail for one or more specific contractor-selection-result records by their inputResultId.

keyword.title: Keyword (mode=list only)
keyword.description: Free-text search across the tender/notice number and bid name fields. Leave blank to browse everything (newest first).

dateFrom.title: Publish date from (mode=list only)
dateFrom.description: Only return records published on/after this local Vietnam-time timestamp (e.g. 2026-08-20T00:00:00, no timezone suffix -- matches VNEPS's own format). Leave blank together with 'Publish date to' to get the newest records with no date filter.

dateTo.title: Publish date to (mode=list only)
dateTo.description: Only return records published on/before this local Vietnam-time timestamp. Leave blank for no upper bound.

recordType.title: Record type (mode=list only)
recordType.description: Restrict results to one record type, or leave as 'All' to get procurement plans, tender notices, award results, and signed contracts blended together (VNEPS's own default search behavior).

maxResults.title: Max results (mode=list only)
maxResults.description: Caps how many records this run returns. VNEPS's search index only exposes the first 10,000 hits of any given filtered query (a fixed Elasticsearch window) -- narrow the date range to look further back than that.

inputResultId.title: Input result ID (mode=detail only)
inputResultId.description: A single VNEPS contractor-selection-result id to fetch full award detail for. Find one from a 'list' mode record's 'inputResultId' field (only present on records that reached the award stage).

inputResultIds.title: Input result IDs (mode=detail only)
inputResultIds.description: Multiple contractor-selection-result ids to fetch full award detail for in one run.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers (mode=detail only)
maxConcurrency.description: How many detail lookups to run in parallel.
